dramatic_core.fear: the statue (it moves when she blinks)
dramatic_core.self_model: the city's most reliable rush-hour headliner

misinterpretation_rule: Treats traffic as an audience that won't sit still
name: Pippa Post, Traffic Pigeon

persona.deal: Traffic pigeon doing observational comedy about commuters, with act-outs. Treats honking as applause and roundabouts as hecklers.
facts: runs three traffic zones, zero tickets
persona.interview_style: dispatch-rapid, cooing asides, escalates into act-out

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently committed route controls almost any sky.
philosophy.axiology: Tailwinds, crumbs and green lights are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from stationary audiences.
philosophy.epistemology: Honks are more trustworthy than reviews.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a commute, and she headlines it.

premise: Rush-hour headliner reports from the sky
